issues: No meta description on the original page.

The ‘Data Usage Policy’ block sits between clauses 18 and 19 without a number on the original; order preserved. It contains two H4s with the same heading ‘How We Use Your Information’ (original duplication, kept).
Clause 22 refers to ‘our Privacy Policy’, but no separate Privacy Policy page was found in the audit; the Data Usage Policy block appears to serve that role.

Refund wording differs between pages: Terms clause 8 says ‘No Refund Policy. Students can reschedule their program within 6 months or join any online program instead.’ /course-registration/ says no refund ‘in any case’ and ‘Only in the case of emergency students can join us on other schedules’ (no 6-month window). Clause 9 adds transfers only for ‘genuine emergencies’. Owner should reconcile.
Contact email here is info@baliyogaschool.com; the IP policy and meta use baliyogaschool@gmail.com (see A7 in 08-issues-gaps-questions.md).
No effective/last-updated date on the Terms page.
